items.title: 54271_Charlie Holmes oral history interview
items.q: The only name band I'd known him to be in was Erskine Hawkins. ... Yeah, I remember that.

ctx.x: Well, he wouldn't be listed unless he did something. Unless he was in one of the big-name bands or something. The only name band I'd known him to be in was Erskine Hawkins.
Because the personnel of the sax sections of Erskine Hawkins has William Johnson, Jimmy Mitchell, Paul Bascomb and Haywood Henry.
